bull.t: Sustained Product Revenue Growth & Upgraded Guidance
bull.b: Significant and sustained AUCATZYL sales growth and an upgraded FY26 revenue guide demonstrate durable commercial adoption across treatment centers. The guidance lift improves near-term revenue visibility, supports scale economics, and reduces sole reliance on financing over the next 2–6 months.

bull.t: Material Gross Margin Improvement & Manufacturing Scale
bull.b: Gross margin stepping to 55% and a 65–70% mature margin target reflect meaningful operational leverage. Early production at the Nucleus facility and cost reductions indicate scalable manufacturing economics that can sustainably lower cost of goods and improve cash conversion as volumes grow.

bull.t: Extended Runway via Senior Credit Facility
bull.b: The senior secured notes facility plus the initial $75M draw, and expected first two tranches (~$100M combined), materially extend funded runway into Q2 2028 when combined with revenue. This provides funded visibility to execute commercialization and planned data catalysts over a multiyear horizon.

bear.t: Persistent Negative Cash Flow & High Burn
bear.b: Large negative operating and free cash flows show ongoing heavy cash burn that tracks net losses. Sustained negative FCF forces reliance on external financing or rapid margin/revenue improvement to fund operations, heightening dilution and liquidity risk over the medium term.

Material portions of available financing depend on meeting revenue milestones and timing windows. Access to up to $150M of tranches is conditional, so failure to hit sales thresholds could compress runway, force cost-cutting, or require more dilutive financing, increasing execution risk.

bear.t: Elevated SG&A and Ongoing Operating Losses
bear.b: Commercialization has raised SG&A while R&D remains high, producing sizable operating losses. This structurally higher cost base tied to launch activities can limit near-term free cash flow and delays company-level profitability unless revenue growth and margin gains continue as projected.
